title: The Wrong Seal
summary: A crate at the relay has been waiting on the eastern bridge for weeks.

stages.text: Jory mentioned a crate bound east that has been waiting since the bridge went out. Something about it bothers you.
stages.hint: The manifest is on the lectern; the crates are stacked on the east side of the relay.

objectives.text: Look at the seal on the strongbox

stages.text: Three things that don't quite agree. Put them side by side.
stages.hint: Open the journal (J) and look at the Case Board.

objectives.text: Form a theory on the Case Board

stages.text: You could tell Jory what you noticed, or keep it to yourself for now.

objectives.text: Decide what to do about it

stages.text: Whatever the crate is, it isn't going anywhere, and neither is your parcel. The bridgewarden will know when the Eastfall crossing reopens.
stages.hint: The Bridgewarden's hut is at the very end of the east road.

objectives.text: Ask the bridgewarden about the crossing

completion_text: The Eastfall crossing is still out. The road east will have to wait.
